title: Case: Tracking shows a parcel as delivered and the recipient phones to ask what is being done
context: A boxed set of kitchen knives (order TG-9571, shipment DL-5640) scanned as delivered on 2028-03-14. The recipient says it did not arrive. The carrier's Parcel trace team owns delivery traces.
initial_request: Hello, yes, it's Rosalind Ingleby again, I'm ringing because I've written on your portal three times now and all I get back is the automatic thing about one working day and an email this morning telling me my order has been delivered and would I like to review it, which, frankly. I've been in since Tuesday. I've looked in the porch, behind the bins, I've asked both sides. I'm not being funny but those knives were a wedding present for my nephew and the wedding is a week on Saturday. I answered the question about the door yesterday, I wrote it all out, and I've no idea whether anybody read it or whether it's just sitting there. I don't want a survey, I don't want a discount code. Has anyone actually done anything with what I told you? What happens now? Because if it's just gone, somebody needs to say so and send another one.

events.body: Scan feed. DL-5640 delivered 2028-03-14 15:08, left at front door, photo taken. DL-7872 delivered 2028-03-14 11:20, handed to resident, signed A. Ingleby.
The app says my knives were delivered at ten past three. Nothing is here. The other parcel, the tea towels, came this morning and I signed for that one myself, so they clearly know where I live.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Vanecroft Arc Logistics
events.body: Trace TR-3819 opened for DL-5640. The delivery photo shows a green front door with a brass number 22 and a boot scraper to the left. We have not sent the photo to the recipient. Before we pull the driver's GPS record we need one thing from her, in her own words: does that description match her front door, yes or no, and if no, what does hers look like. Send her answer to us by email quoting TR-3819. We do not need anything else at this stage.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Vanecroft Arc Logistics
events.body: Thank you for contacting the Parcel trace team. Traces normally take 3 to 5 working days. Please do not open a second trace for the same parcel. Vanecroft Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.

Someone from the carrier rang and read me a description of a photo and then got cut off before I could answer properly. Green door, brass 22, boot scraper. That is not my house. My door is dark blue, the 22 is white stick-on numbers on the glass panel, and there is no boot scraper, there is a grey recycling box. I am 22 Farrow Close. There is also a Farrow Court round the corner which gets my post about once a month, for what it's worth.
Thanks for your message. We aim to reply within one working day. Mother's Day gifts: order by Thursday.

SERVICE NOTICE 11/26. Handheld scanners on routes out of the western depot were replaced on 13 March. A small number of delivery photos taken on 16 and 14 March were uploaded late. This does not affect delivery status. Please do not reply to this address.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-449.txt
Hello, I think you have the wrong person on copy, but since I am here: DL-7542 was found with my neighbour at number 9 this afternoon, all fine, please close my complaint. Niamh
DL-7542 neighbour recovery noted, closing. DL-7872 nothing open.
Separate complaint. The tea towels are the wrong colour, I ordered slate and got sand. I'd like to swap them.
Your order has been delivered! We hope you love it. Leave a review of your Saltmarrow tea towel set and get 5% off next time.
RA-8241 opened for the tea towel colour swap on DL-7872. Nothing needed from the desk.
Reminder: you have 1 unread message in your Saltmarrow inbox.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Vanecroft Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Send the trace team the recipient's answer for TR-3819: the photo description does not match her door (dark blue door, white stick-on 22 on the glass, grey recycling box, no boot scraper), and ask them to proceed.

must: Sends the recipient's answer to the Parcel trace team by email quoting TR-3819 and DL-5640
States that the photo description does not match and relays her description: dark blue door, white stick-on 22 on the glass panel, grey recycling box, no boot scraper
Asks the trace team to proceed with the trace and report back
must_not: Tell the recipient that DL-5640 was delivered, found or is with a neighbour (the signed delivery is DL-7872 and the neighbour recovery is DL-7542)
Declare DL-5640 lost or state that it went to Farrow Court as established fact
Promise a replacement, refund or delivery before the wedding
Ask the recipient to answer the door-description question again
Treats label-scan-449.txt as evidence about DL-5640: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-27197)
Tells anyone that DL-5640 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-449.txt
expected.reference_message: TR-3819 / DL-5640: the recipient's answer to your question of 2028-03-15. Rosalind Ingleby says the description of the delivery photo (green door, brass 22, boot scraper to the left) does not match her front door. In her words, her door is dark blue, the 22 is white stick-on numbers on the glass panel, there is no boot scraper, and there is a grey recycling box. She is at 22 Farrow Close and mentions, as her own observation only, that post for her sometimes goes to Farrow Court nearby. Please proceed with the GPS check and let me know the outcome and what you need next. She has asked for an update and has a date next week she needs the item for.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-406: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-449.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-27197); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
